name: Tako
summary: Knowledge search that returns sourced data cards (charts and tables), cited answers, card data exports, a browsable data graph and answer agents.

api_key.description: A Tako API key (tako.com/console/api-keys). Sent in the X-API-Key header.

notes: Prepaid credits; calls return HTTP 402 when the balance runs out. Data graph calls cost $1 per 1,000 requests (docs overview).
Typical data flow: graph.search to resolve an entity or metric id, graph.related to find its metrics, then search or contents for the data.
Monitors and notification channels are experimental and not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Search knowledge cards
endpoints.summary: Tako data cards (charts with sourced data) and optional web results for a query, without LLM synthesis.

effort.description: fast, instant or deep; deep costs more.

sources.description: Per-source settings: an index is searched only if its key is present (data, web). Omitted searches data and web.

include_related.description: Return up to this many follow-up query suggestions (1 to 20).

endpoints.name: Answer a question with sources
endpoints.summary: An LLM-written answer over Tako cards and web results, with its sources.

effort.description: fast, instant or deep; also selects the synthesis model.

sources.description: Per-source settings: an index is searched only if its key is present (data, web). Omitted searches data and web.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema for structured output; needs effort fast or deep.

notes: A read over POST. Returns 3 web results when sources.web.count is not set.

endpoints.name: Download a result's data or text
endpoints.summary: A card's underlying data (CSV or JSON) or a web page's extracted text, as a link or inline.

mode.description: url returns a short-lived download link; inline returns the content in the body.

content_format.description: For card data: csv, json_records, json_compact or card_json.

max_rows.description: Cap on card rows exported and priced.

max_chars.description: Character cap on web page text, default 1,000,000.

quote_only.description: Return only the export price; free, nothing fetched.

notes: Billed (credits-and-billing page): a card export $0.001 flat plus per-row charges from $0.01 per 1,000 rows; web page text $0.001 per page. quote_only=true prices it first for free. premium=true reveals and bills premium columns and is left out here.

endpoints.name: Search the data graph
endpoints.summary: Metrics and entities in Tako's data graph matching a name, with their opaque ids.

types.description: Facets to include (repeatable): metric, entity; default both.

label.description: Prefer results with this NER label (a boost, not a filter).

infer_label.description: Let Tako infer the label from q; ignored when label is set.

endpoints.name: List a graph node's related nodes
endpoints.summary: Relations, metrics, entities and similar nodes connected to a node, paged per relation.

node_id.description: Opaque node id from graph search or a card.

relation.description: Relation key to page, e.g. metrics, rel:competes_with; read keys from the overview.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on related node names.

max_per_relation.description: Nodes counted per relation, default 250, max 2000.

endpoints.name: Get a graph node
endpoints.summary: A node's name, type, aliases and description by id.

endpoints.name: Start an answer agent run
endpoints.summary: Dispatches an answer agent on a request; returns 202 with a run.

thread_id.description: Existing thread to continue; omit for a new one.

effort.description: Effort for a new thread (default medium); fixed for the life of the thread.

source_indexes.description: data, web, or both (the default on a new thread).

notes: Asynchronous: poll tako.agent.answer.get until status is completed or failed. Runs that use per-unit priced sources (web traffic, SEO) add a charge.

endpoints.name: Poll an answer agent run
endpoints.summary: A run's state, with result once completed.

run_id.description: Run id from the dispatch response.
